blocks.html: GACL’s remarkable journey has been marked by numerous achievements. In its relentless pursuit of excellence, GACL has attained several significant milestones, earning the company prestigious awards and recognitions in the chemical industry. These accolades stand as a testament to GACL’s commitment to maintaining high standards and innovation in its field.

National CSR Award from World HRD Congress for adopting best CSR
practices

items: GACL Foundation Trust, the CSR arm of Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited, has been honoured with the National CSR Award for adopting best CSR practices through our Home for Mentally Differently-abled Children (HMDC) Project at the CSR Conclave organized by the World HRD Congress in Bangalore.

National Safety Council of India Safety Awards – 2025 awarded the prestigious “Certificate of Merit” for the Manufacturing Sector (Group B) to GACL Vadodara Complex in recognition of appreciable achievement in Occupational Safety & Health during 2022–2024.

blocks.html: Awarded 1st prize at 2nd GEO Excellence Awards 2024 for CSR Initiatives

items: Awarded the Runner Up Trophy at the Gujarat Cleaner Production Award for the Year 2017-18 by the Forests and Environment Department, Government of Gujarat, for the large-scale sector (highly polluting) in September 2024.
Awarded 1st prize at 2nd Gujarat Employers’ Organisation (GEO) Excellence Award 2024 in the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) category for Large Enterprises in March 2024.

blocks.html: Top Performer of Perform Achieve & Trade (PAT) Cycle II under the National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency (NMEEE)

items: GACL has been honoured with the prestigious National Award for its Dahej Complex under the category of Top Performer Designated Consumer for the Chlor Alkali Sector of Perform Achieve & Trade (PAT) Cycle II under the National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency (NMEEE) on the occasion of the 21st BEE Day and the celebration of the 1st Decade of the PAT Scheme—an initiative by the Ministry of Power, Government of India in March 2023.
